payload.prompt: /patch Issue #1: In mas-repository.js:1019, existingTitles is collected using s.get()?.path?.startsWith(folderPath) which matches fragments in subdirectories (e.g. /folder/subfolder/) and folders sharing a name prefix (e.g. /folder-extra/). This results in unnecessary -1 suffixes when the exact folder has no collision, but never in a missed dedup. Resolution: Replace startsWith check with exact folder comparison: s.get()?.path?.split('/').slice(0,-1).join('/') === folderPath Severity: tech_debt
